name: cua-hard/larkspur-map-flatfile
description: Roll out a supplier's corrected 2027 cost/MAP sheet for a multi-channel kitchenware shop: download the Larkspur sheets from Yahoo Mail and the All Listings report from Amazon Seller Central, join them locally with Shopify stock under the co-owner's rules (effective-date cut-off at Black Friday, never lower prices, min = MAP / max = MSRP, FBM quantity = stock - 2 floored at 0, blank quantity on FBA, discontinued items excluded), upload a tab-delimited Price & Quantity flat file back to Seller Central, and raise below-MAP Shopify variants.

metadata.subscenario: 多渠道卖家按供应商 MAP 表批量更新亚马逊价格与库存
